title: Sum of Digits in Base K
summary: Convert an integer n from base 10 to base k, then sum the digits of the converted number, returning the sum in base 10.
statement: Convert an integer n from base 10 to base k, then sum the digits of the converted number, returning the sum in base 10.
constraints: n is positive and k is between two and ten.
Convert n to base k conceptually and return the sum of its digits as a decimal integer.
reference_solution:
def digit_sum_in_base(n, k):
 answer=0
 while n:answer+=n%k;n//=k
 return answer

hints: Repeated division by k exposes one base-k digit at a time.
The remainder n%k is the current least-significant digit.
Add the remainder, replace n by n//k, and stop at zero.
Euclidean division uniquely decomposes n into base-k digits, so the loop visits and sums each digit exactly once.
